description: Fork of exp154 (LUT qk_joint + BitAttention, val_bpb=1.7105). Single change: upgrade unembedder from LN→Linear(384,vocab) to LN→Linear(384,3072)→GELU→Linear(3072,vocab) with bias=False. Same 89M extra unembedder params as exp173. Total ~481M. Tests if the big-unembedder gain (−0.052 in exp173) carries over to LUT-based qk too. Launch with SPIKY_BIT_ATTN_USE_FORWARD_KERNEL=tc SPIKY_BIT_ATTN_USE_BACKWARD_KERNEL=bf16.
